title: Memory of Robinson-Trautman waves
summary: The memory effect for Robinson-Trautman waves is explicitly worked out. In a first step, we construct the combined frame rotation and coordinate transformation in which Robinson-Trautman waves are manifestly locally asymptotically flat at future null infinity. This allows us to apply well-established results on how to derive the memory effect in this context. In a second step, we construct a suitably improved generalized mass aspect that provides a local Lyapunov function for the flow in the sense that it is manifestly positive.
